# Spoken deadline wins

`customer_support.heu.sla_management.spoken_deadline_wins` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **heuristic**

> The deadline the customer holds you to is the one a human said out loud, not the one in the contract.


## The heuristic

**The deadline the customer holds you to is the one a human said out loud, not the one in the contract.**


_Why:_ A contract is read once at signature; a sentence in a reply is read the moment it lands and remembered precisely. This is why an agent quoting a deadline is effectively amending the SLA, and why quoting a deadline you have not checked against coverage is a costly habit.
